description: Obviously synthetic canonical participant on the three-year conviction path. Protected/outside-party fields (docket number, OTN, judge, prosecutor position) stay blank. The three statutory findings are requested of the court, never asserted as made.

chargeData.chargeDescription: Violation of a city ordinance prohibiting theft of property

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of a city ordinance conviction under K.S.A. 12-4516(a)(1), three or more years having elapsed from the latest of satisfying the sentence imposed or discharge from probation, parole or a suspended sentence
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: Three or more years have elapsed since Petitioner satisfied the sentence imposed and was discharged from supervision on the conviction identified above.
additionalFacts: Petitioner asks the Court to set a hearing and to give notice to the prosecuting attorney and the arresting law enforcement agency, as the statute directs.

Petitioner asks the Court to find that Petitioner has not been convicted of a felony in the past two years and that no such proceeding is pending or being instituted; that Petitioner's circumstances and behaviour warrant expungement; and that expungement is consistent with the public welfare.
Petitioner states the circumstances and behaviour relied on in the accompanying statement; that statement is completed by Petitioner and is not supplied by any other person.

attachments: Certified municipal court record and disposition
